name: Against the Hatecrest
summary: At Feathermoon Stronghold, Latronicus Moonspear means to face the Hatecrest naga before they make their move. He asks you to bring him ten Hatecrest Scales in good condition.

sections.title: Acting Before It Is Too Late
sections.body: Latronicus Moonspear expects the naga to try to claim the island someday. He wants to act before they can, so he asks you to bring ten Hatecrest Scales in good condition. You will have to see for yourself how to get them. He hopes gathering the scales will weaken the naga presence on Sardor Isle and give you your first taste of fighting naga.

sections.title: Peace and Duty
sections.body: Latronicus says night elves cherish peace and harmony, not war. Still, he will not leave their interests unguarded. Protecting them is his duty to General Feathermoon and the stronghold.

sections.title: Afterwards
sections.body: Latronicus finds the scales more than satisfactory. He plans to send them to Pratt in case anything useful can be crafted from them. He also has another task for you.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where?
aliases: where to turn in against the hatecrest
faq.answer: Latronicus Moonspear asks for the scales and receives them at Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Why does Latronicus Moonspear want Hatecrest scales?
faq.answer: Latronicus expects the naga to try to secure Sardor Isle someday, so he wants to act first. Gathering scales may weaken their presence there.
You need ten Hatecrest Scales in good condition.

faq.q: Where are the Hatecrest naga found?
faq.answer: Latronicus speaks of a naga presence on Sardor Isle.
